resources.string: Finished turns and prompts from your desktop sessions.
OmpDeck needs a newer Android System WebView (or Chrome) to run. Update it in Google Play, then reopen OmpDeck.

Notifications are delivered through Firebase Cloud Messaging, using a Firebase project you own. This app ships with none.

1. In the Firebase console, create a project and add an Android app with the package name %1$s.
2. Download its google-services.json.
3. Import it here.

The file stays on this phone (encrypted) and is only used to register with your Firebase project. Notification content is end-to-end encrypted between your desktop and this phone.
Firebase could not register this phone
The imported Firebase configuration did not produce a notification token (wrong project, no network or no Google Play services). You can remove it and import a different google-services.json.
Allow notifications for OmpDeck in the system settings to get desktop alerts on this phone.
